items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: And Stan's the same, he's up there with a bunch of real young guys. He gets them -- they both get them out of the same source...

ctx.x: It wasn't on the tape? He was over at the table and I looked up at the bandstand and I said, 'Woody,

do you remember when we were stealing men from each other back in the '40s?" I said, "None of these guys were even born then." He says, "You're right." It's -- and Stan's the same, he's up there with a bunch of real young guys. He gets them -- they both get them out of the same source, North Texas State and Indiana and the Berklee School of Music and back in Massachusetts. And these guys come out and I don't know where they're going to go, because only a fraction of them can make it into the studios. There's only…
of the question. A lot of people keep saying, 'Oh, when is it coming back?' Well, it's not coming back.
